# KT INDIA website (proposed replacement for kavaiyatech.com)

**Stack:** plain HTML, CSS and a 4 KB script, generated by a zero-dependency Node script. This is the simplest option that is fast, secure and needs no framework updates. The current site is already hand-coded static HTML on Apache, so nothing new has to be learned.

```
03-new-site/
  build.mjs              generator: templates, schema, sitemap, robots, placeholder report
  src/content.mjs        ALL site copy and company facts (edit text here)
  src/mark.mjs           concept logo mark (SVG)
  src/logo-source.png    original KT logo, kept as a fallback
  src/static/            CSS, JS, images, PDF, _headers, _redirects, .htaccess, manifest
  scripts/serve.mjs      local preview that applies _headers/_redirects like production
  scripts/check-links.mjs crawls the preview and checks every link and #fragment
  scripts/make-images.mjs regenerates icons and the share image (dev only, needs Playwright)
  dist/                  BUILT SITE: this folder is what gets uploaded
  PLACEHOLDERS.md        generated list of content the client must supply
```

## Build and preview locally

Requires Node 18 or newer. There are no npm dependencies.

```bash
cd 03-new-site
node build.mjs                 # writes dist/
node scripts/serve.mjs 8080    # http://localhost:8080
node scripts/check-links.mjs   # in a second terminal
```

## Before going live (required)

1. **Contact form:** create a free form at https://formspree.io, copy the form ID, and in `src/content.mjs` replace `FORM_ID` in `formAction`. Rebuild. Formspree adds spam filtering, and the form also has a honeypot field (`_gotcha`). If you switch to another provider, update `formAction` and the `connect-src`/`form-action` entries in the CSP (`src/static/_headers`, `.htaccess`, `vercel.json`).
2. **Placeholders:** replace every item in `PLACEHOLDERS.md` (they show as yellow dashed marks on the page) or remove that block in `build.mjs`.
3. **Logo:** the site uses a concept mark (`src/mark.mjs`). To keep the original logo instead, see "Using the original logo" below.
4. Rebuild with `node build.mjs`.

## Deploy

### Netlify
1. New site → Import from Git (or drag-and-drop `dist/` into app.netlify.com/drop).
2. Build command `node build.mjs`, publish directory `dist` (already in `netlify.toml`).
3. Netlify applies `dist/_headers` (security headers and caching) and `dist/_redirects` (old URLs) automatically.
4. Domains → add `www.kavaiyatech.com` and `kavaiyatech.com` (set www as primary). Netlify issues HTTPS automatically.

### Vercel
1. New Project → import the repository, set **Root Directory** to `03-new-site`.
2. Framework preset "Other". `vercel.json` already sets build command, output directory, headers and redirects.
3. Add both domains in Project → Settings → Domains and redirect the apex to www.

### Cloudflare Pages
1. Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → connect the repository.
2. Root directory `03-new-site`, build command `node build.mjs`, output directory `dist`.
3. `_headers` and `_redirects` in `dist/` are read automatically.
4. Custom domains → add `www.kavaiyatech.com`; add a redirect rule from the apex to www.

### Traditional hosting (current Apache/StackCDN host, cPanel, any FTP host)
1. Run `node build.mjs` on your computer (or use the committed `dist/`).
2. Upload the **contents** of `dist/` (including the hidden `.htaccess`) to the web root (`public_html/`), replacing the old files. Keep a backup of the old site first.
3. `.htaccess` forces HTTPS and www, sets security headers and caching, maps old URLs and serves `404.html`. Requires `mod_rewrite` and `mod_headers` (standard on Apache hosts).
4. If you keep the existing careers form, leave the old `api/` folder in place on the server. The new pages do not use it unless you reconnect it.

### After launch (all hosts)
- Google Search Console: verify the domain, submit `https://www.kavaiyatech.com/sitemap.xml`, and use URL Inspection on the home page.
- Test headers at https://securityheaders.com and previews at https://www.opengraph.xyz.
- Publish DMARC (see the audit, F10). This is DNS, not website, work.

## Editing content
- Text and facts: `src/content.mjs` (services, sectors, programmes, careers, company details).
- Page layouts: the page sections in `build.mjs`.
- Styles: `src/static/css/site.css` (colour tokens at the top).
- Then run `node build.mjs`.

## Using the original logo
In `build.mjs`, `header()` replace `${markSvg('mark brand-mark', 'gh')}` with an `<img src="/img/logo-96.png" width="40" height="40" alt="">`. Change `scripts/make-images.mjs` to read `src/logo-source.png` (the earlier version of this script did exactly that), then run `node scripts/make-images.mjs` and rebuild.

## Accessibility and motion
- Targets WCAG 2.2 AA: skip link, landmarks, visible focus, 44–48 px touch targets, labelled form fields, sufficient contrast, logical headings.
- The mobile menu uses the native `popover` attribute, so it works without JavaScript and closes with Escape. Older browsers fall back to an inline menu.
- All animation uses transform/opacity, pauses on hover and is switched off when the visitor sets "reduce motion". Scroll reveals use CSS scroll-driven animations, so content is always visible in browsers that don't support them.
- Forced-colours (Windows high contrast) mode is supported.
